premises.text: Medical tourism is dominated by travel agents who leave doctors unvetted, producing poor outcomes and lack of trust
premises.evidence_span: this industry is dominated by travel agents, individuals who sell flights and hotels, and on occasion, slap on a hip replacement

premises.text: Patients travel abroad to save money, save wait time, or gain access to procedures unavailable at home
premises.evidence_span: three main reasons patients travel for medical care. The first is to save money

premises.text: MedRepublic is an online marketplace connecting American and Canadian patients with English-speaking, board-certified, top-rated doctors abroad
premises.evidence_span: online global health marketplace that enables American and Canadian patients to connect with English-speaking, board-certified, top-rated doctors around the world

premises.text: Doctors undergo strict U.S. Board of Physicians vetting (accepting ~5%) and are ranked by ratings, proximity, and responsiveness with transparent pricing
premises.evidence_span: Each of our doctors go through a strict vetting process led by our U.S. Board of Physicians

premises.text: HIPAA-compliant chat/video/file sharing plus marketplace admin of documents, records, and payments lets doctors focus on care
premises.evidence_span: Using our HIPAA-compliant communication center, participants are able to live chat, video conference, as well as share important medical files

value.text: A transparent, secure, trusted marketplace for world-class medical care abroad
value.evidence_span: create a transparent, secure, and trusted marketplace to facilitate world-class medical care

causal_links.evidence_span: lack of expertise, which for patients means unvetted doctors and poor outcomes, leads to a lack of trust
connect with English-speaking, board-certified, top-rated doctors around the world

notes: Three traveler motives kept as one demand bundle (P2). Procedure savings and beta procedure counts excluded as traction. Family guidebook biography motivates trust expertise but is not coded as a premise.
